# Game Idea: Cosmic Dodger

- Control a spaceship using arrow keys on an HTML canvas.
- Asteroids spawn from random edges and drift across the screen.
- Shoot or dodge asteroids to survive.
- **Lose condition:** the ship collides with any asteroid.
- Simple scoring based on the number of asteroids avoided.

<content>
1: // Cosmic Dodger – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9:   // Audio setup
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   // Ensure audio context resumes after first user interaction
12:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
13:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
14:   }, { once: true });
15: 
16:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
20:     osc.type = 'sine';
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     osc.start();
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:   }
27: 
28:   function playCollision() { playTone(150, 0.3); }
29:   function playScore() { playTone(440, 0.05); }
30:   // Starfield background
31:   const starCount = 120;
32:   const stars = Array.from({ length: starCount }, () => ({
33:     x: Math.random() * width,
34:     y: Math.random() * height,
35:   }));
36: 
37:   // Ship definition
38:   const ship = {
39:     x: width / 2,
40:     y: height / 2,
41:     size: 12,
42:     speed: 3,
43:     dx: 0,
44:     dy: 0,
45:   };
46: 
47:   // Input handling
48:   const keys = {};
49:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
50:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
51: 
52:   // Asteroid pool
53:   const asteroids = [];
54:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
55:   let lastSpawn = 0;
56:   let score = 0;
57:   let gameOver = false;
58: 
59:   function spawnAsteroid() {
60:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4); // 0: top,1:right,2:bottom,3:left
61:     let x, y, vx, vy;
62:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
63:     if (edge === 0) { // top
64:       x = Math.random() * width;
65:       y = -20;
66:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
67:       vy = speed;
68:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
69:       x = width + 20;
70:       y = Math.random() * height;
71:       vx = -speed;
72:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
73:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
74:       x = Math.random() * width;
75:       y = height + 20;
76:       vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
77:       vy = -speed;
78:     } else { // left
79:       x = -20;
80:       y = Math.random() * height;
81:       vx = speed;
82:       vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
83:     }
84:     const r = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
85:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r });
86:   }
87: 
88:   function update(dt) {
89:     // Ship movement
90:     ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
91:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
92:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.dx = ship.speed;
93:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
94:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = ship.speed;
95:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, ship.x + ship.dx));
96:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, ship.y + ship.dy));
97: 
98:     // Spawn asteroids
99:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
100:       spawnAsteroid();
101:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
102:     }
103: 
104:     // Move asteroids and remove off‑screen ones
105:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
106:       const a = asteroids[i];
107:       a.x += a.vx;
108:       a.y += a.vy;
109:       if (a.x < -30 || a.x > width + 30 || a.y < -30 || a.y > height + 30) {
110:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
111:         score++;
112:         playScore();
113:       } else if (Math.hypot(a.x - ship.x, a.y - ship.y) < a.r + ship.size) {
114:           playCollision();
115:           gameOver = true;
116:       }
117:     }
118:   }
119: 
120:   function draw() {
121:   // Background gradient
122:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
123:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
124:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
125:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
126:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
127:   // Starfield
128:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
129:   stars.forEach(s => { ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1); });
130:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
131:     // Ship – gradient triangle
132:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y - ship.size, ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
133:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffea');
134:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0077ff');
135:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
136:     ctx.beginPath();
137:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size);
138:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
139:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
140:     ctx.closePath();
141:     ctx.fill();
142:     // Asteroids – shaded circles
143:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
144:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
145:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#b0b0b0');
146:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#3a3a3a');
147:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
148:       ctx.beginPath();
149:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
150:       ctx.fill();
151:     });
152:     // Score
153:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
154:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
155:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
156:     // Game over overlay
157:     if (gameOver) {
158:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
159:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
160:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
161:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
162:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
163:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   let lastTime = 0;
168:   function loop(timestamp) {
169:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
170:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
171:     lastTime = timestamp;
172:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
173:     draw();
174:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:   }
176:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
177: })();

(End of file - total 177 lines)
</content>
